text:
alex: FYI I noticed the Next + LangChain starter (langnext-template) is firing duplicate embedding requests during client hydration. looks like a client-side retry + server warmup race and we're getting billed twice. anyone seen this pattern?

priya: I can repro. Steps: open home page -> client fetch runs during hydration -> server-side prewarm also kicks an embed call -> SDK retries on 429s and duplicates. logs: 
```
[2025-01-12T09:12:11.001Z] INFO embeddings:start client request /api/embed 429 Too Many Requests
[2025-01-12T09:12:11.101Z] DEBUG sdk retry attempt=1 retryAfter=100ms
[2025-01-12T09:12:11.102Z] INFO embeddings:start server prewarm /api/embed 200 OK
[2025-01-12T09:12:11.203Z] DEBUG sdk retry attempt=2 retryAfter=200ms
```
alex: interesting that prewarm wins but client keeps retrying and then eventually succeeds, so two embeddings recorded.

tom: this is nasty for demos and for new users who hit rate limits. quick mitigation: debounce the client embed request and check for an in-progress cookie/session key before calling. also set SDK option `retryOnRateLimit: false` in client config until we improve idempotency.

priya: tried debounce and it helps, but the root cause is SDK doesn't expose a per-request idempotency key for embeddings (only for generative requests). we should add an idempotency header (x-redwood-id) and ignore duplicates server-side if identical within short window.

alex: can we also change default retry behavior on browser-side to exponential backoff with jitter and an upper cap? right now it retries very aggressively on 429s.

tom: agreed. I'll open an SDK PR to: 1) add retryOnRateLimit config (default true for server, false for browser), 2) implement idempotency header support in embeddings API, 3) add a small e2e test in the langnext-template that simulates duplicate requests. i'll include changelog and migration notes.

priya: thanks. for the template README I'll add a note to prefer server-side embeddings and show the debounce pattern. also will add an eval-harness check that fails the demo if it records >1 embed for a single demo session.

infra-bot: Created ticket INF-842: "embedding idempotency + client retry policy" assigned to tom. Priority: P2. :clipboard: 

ci-bot: tom opened PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/523 - "embeddings: idempotency header + client retry defaults". Running CI...

alex: quick local check of the PR branch passed for me. client duplicate calls prevented with debounce + id header. thanks tom.

ci-bot: CI checks passed for PR #523 (unit, integration). Merging to main in 5m. :rocket:

priya: once merged I'll run the langnext-template through the eval harness and report any throughput regressions. want to ensure we didn't accidentally increase latency with idempotency checks.

alex: cool. leaving a follow-up to add a cookbook entry on "avoiding duplicate embeddings in Next apps". :book:
